sentences.text: The living room temperature reached its coldest point at 17.8 °C at 05:40. Since WHO recommends at least 18 °C indoors in cold seasons, this is something to note.
In the ironing room, the humidity was observed at 32.8 % between 04:00 and 06:00.
You might want to check the heating in the living room, as the temperature stayed below 18.0 °C.
